task_instance: Convert the bundled sample Markdown (assets/example.md: frontmatter title, English + Japanese flowcharts, a tall flowchart, a table and lists) into output.docx using scripts/markdown_to_word.py so each Mermaid fence is rendered to an embedded SVG with a 3x PNG fallback.
blocker_detail: The skill renders each Mermaid fence with the bundled Mermaid CLI (mmdc), which drives a headless Chromium through Puppeteer. The npm install placed a working Chromium under the user cache, but the sandbox executes as the root user and Chromium refuses to launch for a root user unless the browser sandbox is disabled (the launch aborts with a zygote error stating that running as root without the no-sandbox flag is unsupported). The SKILL.md explicitly instructs not to disable the browser sandbox to make a conversion pass, and the converter's generated Puppeteer config sets only the executable path and adds no such flag. Rendering therefore fails and no SVG/PNG is produced, so the DOCX deliverable cannot be generated while following the skill. This is an environment artifact (running as root) rather than a missing runtime ability; a browser is present and the runtime grants browser operation.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r137 . Checked tooling: python 3.13.17, node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4; no system chrome/chromium on PATH. Created .venv and installed the three declared Python deps (markdown-it-py, python-docx, lxml); 'import markdown_it, docx, lxml' succeeded. Ran 'npm install --prefix ./run/mermaid-cli @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli' successfully; mmdc shim present at run/mermaid-cli/node_modules/.bin/mmdc and Puppeteer downloaded Chromium into the user puppeteer cache (chrome/linux-156.0.8078.47). Direct smoke test 'mmdc -i t.mmd -o t.svg' on a trivial flowchart failed with 'Failed to launch the browser process' and a Chromium zygote error: running as root without the no-sandbox flag is not supported; no t.svg was produced (exit 1 from the browser). Copied scripts/markdown_to_word.py and assets/example.md into the work dir as input.md; the converter invokes the same mmdc, whose Puppeteer config (puppeteer-config.json) sets only executablePath and no sandbox-disabling args, so its Mermaid render step hits the identical root/sandbox launch failure before any SVG/PNG or DOCX is created. Not achieved: the rendered-diagram DOCX deliverable could not be produced without disabling the browser sandbox, which the skill forbids.
